news.title: NBCC (India)’s net profit rises 34% to ₹209.84 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: NBCC (India) has revealed a 33.9 percent increase in net profit after tax for the quarter, fueled by a healthy 14.6 percent growth in total income. Over the first half of the fiscal year, the company also registered a 5.4 percent rise in total income. To reward shareholders, the board has declared an interim dividend of ₹0.

news.title: Eldeco Housing’s net profit jumps 181% to ₹7.38 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: In Q2 FY27, Eldeco Housing and Industries reported an impressive 180.6 percent surge in net consolidated profit, showcasing significant financial growth. The total income skyrocketed by 49.8 percent compared to the same quarter last fiscal year. Despite a 16.6 percent drop in booked area, booking values rose by 7.8 percent. Notably, collections surged to ₹125.6 crore, marking a 37.5 percent increase, with 125 units delivered amidst a fewer project launches.

news.title: Arvind SmartSpaces’ net profit rises 26% to ₹22.74 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: In Q2 FY27, Arvind SmartSpaces reported a remarkable 25.9 percent rise in net profit compared to the same quarter last year. The company's total income saw an impressive 12.8 percent growth. Bookings during this period surpassed ₹906 crore, more than doubling year-on-year. A favorable market response is evident, as H1 FY27 bookings and collections demonstrated strong upward trends.

news.title: Aadhar Housing Finance’s net profit rises 16% to ₹308.29 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: Aadhar Housing Finance has achieved an impressive 15.7% increase in net consolidated profit after tax for Q2 FY27. During this quarter, the firm also reported a total income surge of 16.5%, totaling ₹1,047.76 crore. As of September 30, 2026, their assets under management rose by 18% to reach ₹32,643 crore. Loan disbursements climbed 22% to ₹2,577 crore, while they maintained a net profit margin of 29.

news.title: Signature Global posts ₹66.90 crore net profit in Q2 FY27
news.para: Signatureglobal (India) has registered a consolidated profit of ₹66.90 crore for Q2 FY27 after a loss last year. The company's total income saw a remarkable increase to ₹870.70 crore compared to ₹372.51 crore in the previous fiscal quarter. Land acquisition in Gurugram includes approximately 1.1014 acres with a buildable area of 0.1 million sq ft.

news.title: Berger Paints’ net profit rises 5% to ₹217.10 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: In the second quarter of FY27, Berger Paints achieved a 5.2% increase in net consolidated profit after tax, alongside a notable 13.3% rise in net income compared to the prior fiscal quarter. Despite these gains, the company's operating profit faced pressures from rising raw material costs and expected price hikes in November.

news.title: SC allows conveyance deeds for Parsvnath homebuyers in completed projects
news.para: The Supreme Court has authorized the execution of conveyance deeds for Parsvnath Developers' homebuyers. This pivotal decision follows extensive legal discussions surrounding the company's insolvency and the rights of homebuyers. Additionally, the court mandated the release of funds to cover critical expenses for affected projects, alleviating the prolonged distress experienced by buyers waiting years for their homes to be completed.

news.title: UK's Barratt Redrow flags slower bookings after 12% decline in home completions
news.para: Barratt Redrow has seen a significant 12% drop in home completions, largely stemming from fewer bookings by individual buyers. The UK housing market is grappling with high mortgage and interest rates, which dampens buyer enthusiasm. The launch of the 'Your First Home' initiative has been less successful than expected, raising concerns about its funding. Consequently, the private reservation rate is lagging behind last year's figures.

news.title: UK's Vistry starts cutting jobs as part of restructuring
news.para: Vistry has initiated workforce reductions as part of its strategic turnaround efforts in response to declining housing demand affected by rising affordability pressures for potential buyers. The company aims to lower its debt through operational consolidation, focusing on a more streamlined regional presence. Although Vistry's forward order book stands at £3.

news.title: Government to complete statewide land resurvey by next year: Telangana revenue minister
news.para: Telangana is set to complete a comprehensive resurvey of all land parcels by next year. This initiative aims to provide legally secure land records to landowners and farmers. Officials will ensure transparency throughout the survey process, while farmers' presence will be mandatory during field operations. Regular oversight will be conducted by officials at various levels to monitor the program's progress.

news.title: Telangana government expands Indiramma Towers housing project to four more cities
news.para: The Telangana government has announced the development of the Indiramma Towers across four cities: Nizamabad, Warangal, Nalgonda, and Karimnagar. Designed to cater to low-income families, these towers will feature one ground floor and five additional levels. The initial phase allocates 4.5 lakh homes, with construction currently underway for 1.9 lakh units and plans for an extra 2.

news.title: Max Estates’ net profit declines 40% to ₹4.67 crore in Q2 FY27
news.para: Max Estates faced a significant downturn, with a net consolidated profit drop of 40.2 percent for Q2 FY27. However, the company thrived in pre-sales, achieving ₹2,092 crore, almost doubling its collections to ₹560 crore over the prior year. Furthermore, the firm has initiated memoranda of understanding for project launches in Ghaziabad and West Delhi, showcasing its commitment to expand its development portfolio, even amid profit challenges.

news.title: Maharashtra: Aadhaar app-based verification made mandatory for property registration from Nov 4
news.para: Starting Wednesday, all property registrations in Maharashtra will require mandatory Aadhaar-based authentication through UIDAI’s app. This new process will enhance identity verification for all parties involved in property transactions. The previous option for a witness to verify failed Aadhaar authentication has been removed. Citizens are encouraged to download the Aadhaar app and complete their registrations before arriving at sub-registrar offices.

news.title: Over 2.2 lakh property cards issued, as Punjab government steps up drive
news.para: The Mera Ghar Mere Naam scheme in Punjab has seen the distribution of more than 2.2 lakh property cards to 1,377 villages. The project’s first phase is expected to finish by November 15, while the second phase is anticipated by the end of the month. This initiative not only helps residents acquire legal ownership but also resolves boundary disputes with advanced drone surveys and on-the-ground verification.

news.title: Vonovia 'concerned' over Berlin left's housing plans
news.para: Europe's leading corporate landlord Vonovia said Wednesday it was "concerned" at plans by Berlin's possible incoming far-left led city administration to expropriate apartments to tackle the city's housing crisis. "Of course, we are concerned about plans to nationalise housing owned by private companies," Vonovia CEO Luka Mucic told reporters Wednesday during a conference call on the company's third-quarter results.

news.title: Telangana defends Future City before NGT, denies clearance violations
news.para: Telangana has responded to the National Green Tribunal regarding allegations about the Future City project. The Future City Development Authority claimed no project approvals or activities have taken place in the designated area. It stated that the information cited by the petitioner was baseless and related to unauthorized sources. The authority emphasized that its tender was only for consultancy services related to planning.

news.title: Bombay HC warns officials over construction noise; says work must stop if prescribed limits are breached
news.para: The Bombay high court has called for regular monitoring of noise pollution at construction sites across Mumbai. This directive aims to prevent residents from being inconvenienced by excessive noise levels. Construction can only resume when developers provide a written assurance of compliance with noise pollution standards. Authorities will be held accountable if noise levels exceed permitted thresholds during future checks.

news.title: Rajasthan drafts affordable housing push with extra BAR, fee waivers for builders
news.para: Rajasthan's urban development department is set to revise the Mukhyamantri Jan Awas Yojana, aiming to incentivize private builders. These modifications will enhance access to affordable housing for low-income families. Notable changes comprise of expanded buildable areas and waived fees, promoting closer housing developments to major projects. Furthermore, the adjustments will elevate the minimum land threshold for such initiatives.

news.title: Dubai's Emaar plans offer to buy out construction arm in $3.4 billion deal
news.para: Emaar Properties plans to launch a cash bid to acquire the outstanding shares of Emaar Development, setting the offer price at 15 dirhams per share. This valuation places the construction division at a remarkable 60 billion dirhams. Even amid regional unrest, shares of Emaar Development saw a minor increase as they approach the offer price.

news.title: Delhi development body registers 80% growth in housing sales during April-October 2026
news.para: The Delhi Development Authority reported selling 9,332 flats during the initial seven months of financial year 2026-27. This figure represents an 80 percent increase compared to the same period last year. Narela has significantly contributed to these sales, accounting for over 90 percent of total sales in the current year. DDA plans to extend booking periods for various housing schemes until December 31, 2026.
